(where the word means ‘a cloud’ also); <ls>R. 14. 22</ls>. .²3 an udder; पयोधरीभूतचतुःसमुद्रां जुगोप गोरूपधरामिवोर्वीम् <ls>R. 2. 3</ls>. .²4 the cocoa-nut tree. .²5 the backbone or spine (कशेरुक).
